locked_conventions.source_domain: h_lambda is defined on [-lambda,lambda] with Lebesgue measure and is zero-extended
locked_conventions.source_normalization: a4=sqrt(3)/2^(11/4); h_lambda tends to h=(pi/2)*x^2*(2*pi*x^2-3)*exp(-pi*x^2), not to a unit-normalized substitute
locked_conventions.finite_state: k_lambda^+=(E(h_lambda)+J*E(h_lambda))/2; inversion evenness is imposed by this average and is not assumed for k_lambda
locked_conventions.matrix_assembly: form the complete real-axis Q=pole+archimedean-prime matrix with every prime power n<=lambda^2 before taking a ground shift, parity compression, inverse, cofactor, or pole deletion
locked_conventions.pole_deletion_order: assemble and shift the complete source matrix first; subtract only the finite projected pole form afterward
locked_conventions.finite_pole_vectors: p_+=P_(E_N^+)cosh(y/2) and p_-=P_(E_N^-)sinh(y/2); continuum vectors are not substituted
locked_conventions.nonpole_shift: m_0=m_lambda(0) is subtracted exactly before the Bernstein-Levy form is written; the interval state is zero-extended before every translation
locked_conventions.half_paired_trace: Z_0=sum_(k=1)^N rho_k^(-2); the trace over both roots is not substituted
locked_conventions.parameter_ingestion: decimal source parameters are parsed directly and never through binary64
locked_conventions.secret_boundary: API keys and environment secrets are neither read nor serialized

locked_formulas.shifted_parity_blocks: T_+=Q_+-epsilon*I is positive semidefinite with kernel C*x and T_-=Q_--epsilon*I is positive definite
locked_formulas.uniform_reserve_equivalence: when N/L^2 is bounded away from zero, sup Z_0<infinity iff inf(-sqrt(L)*d_0)>0
locked_formulas.odd_pole_deletion: S_-=T_-+2*|p_-><p_-| is positive definite, kappa_-=<p_-,S_-^(-1)*p_->, and delta_-=1-2*kappa_->0
locked_formulas.zero_extension_dirichlet_form: <f,Af>=(1/2)*integral_R integral_R abs(tilde(f)(x+h)-tilde(f)(x))^2 nu_lambda(dh) dx>=0 for A=m_lambda(D)-m_0*I
locked_formulas.levy_shift_location: with z=epsilon-m_0, S_+=A_+-z*I and S_-=A_--z*I; inertia gives lambda_1(A_+)<z<lambda_2(A_+) and z<lambda_1(A_-)
locked_formulas.mixed_source_equation: v_+=S_+^(-1)*p_+ solves <f,(m_lambda-epsilon)v_+>=<f,p_+> weakly for every f in E_N^+
locked_formulas.actual_arithmetic_target: -<e_0^+,v_+> is bounded below by a positive constant times L^(-1/2)
locked_formulas.killed_markov_countermodel: for P>1, p=(P,1), x=(1,1), v=(1,-1), T=v*v^T, z=2*P^2+2*P+1, and A=T-2*p*p^T+z*I, A is a positive killed symmetric jump form, A+2*p*p^T has ground x at z, and <(1,1)/sqrt(2),(A-z*I)^(-1)*p>=-1/(sqrt(2)*(P+1))->0
locked_formulas.cauchy_countermodel_mixed_entry: at alpha=L/(4*pi), d_0=-3*sqrt(L)*(alpha^2+1)/(8*sinh(L/4)*(4*alpha^2+3)), hence -sqrt(L)*d_0 tends to zero

locked_domains.finite_even_gate: the complete source matrix has a simple real inversion-even lowest eigenvector x; T_+ has kernel C*x; the source boundary scalar c=<eta,x>, x_0, and h=<p_+,x> are nonzero
locked_domains.finite_odd_gate: T_- is positive definite, so the quotient roots are real and positive and delta_->0
locked_domains.uniform_zero_height_equivalence: the finite even and odd gates hold along a family and N/L^2 is bounded away from zero
locked_domains.diagonal_sufficient_gate: the source-specific negative diagonal estimate c_0<=-kappa/L holds with one fixed kappa>0; inertia alone does not imply it
locked_domains.principal_schur_gate: N>=1, C is the e_0-orthogonal principal block of the complete shifted T_+, and the centered finite pole vectors retain their locked phase
locked_domains.levy_spectral_gate: the exact nonpole multiplier is shifted by m_lambda(0), compressed after zero extension, and then shifted by z=epsilon-m_lambda(0); positivity before this last shift is not promoted across its first even eigenvalue
locked_domains.countermodel_scope: the rational, Cauchy, and killed-Markov families are structural countermodels only and are not identified with the arithmetic source multiplier
